Content: “彩虹牌匾计划”是英国的一项计划，旨在通过安装纪念牌匾来彰显LGBTQIA+历史上的重要人物、地点和时刻。该计划效仿了由英格兰遗产委员会、地方当局及其他机构运营的成熟的英国蓝色牌匾计划，第一块永久性彩虹牌匾（一块蓝色圆形牌匾，周边环绕六色彩虹）于2018年7月在约克揭幕。英国一些LGBT地点则以粉色牌匾标示，这一想法早于彩虹牌匾。历史：彩虹牌匾计划于2018年由约克公民信托基金和约克LGBT论坛发起，旨在纪念女同性恋日记作家安妮·李斯特（1791-1840）及其伴侣安·沃克。第一版牌匾于2018年7月24日揭幕，后于2019年2月更换为包含“女同性恋”一词的修订版本。在2018年的约克和2019年的利兹的LGBT骄傲运动期间，临时纸板牌匾也被放置在关键地点。随后，这项永久性牌匾计划通过旺兹沃思LGBTQ+论坛和伏尔泰工作室扩展到全国，分别于2019年7月24日在克拉珀姆交汇火车站为奥斯卡·王尔德揭幕了永久性牌匾，并于2021年9月10日在南兰贝斯的威尔科克斯路为1980年代的电影《我美丽的洗衣店》揭幕了牌匾。2023年，在伦敦市长“未被讲述的故事基金”和旺兹沃思绿洲的支持下，伦敦宣布将再增设五块彩虹牌匾。

Content: First sit vs resit (student guidance) A first sit is the first opportunity to take an assessment. If granted following an approved EC claim, it allows you to take the assessment as if for the first time (no fee). Where a first sit is awarded due to EC, the original attempt is not marked or the mark is voided (from 25 September 2023). A resit is offered after failure. For undergraduate degrees, resit marks appear on the transcript as a second attempt and are used for progression, but do not contribute to final degree classification

Content: 2.1 Definition of EC Students may face exceptional personal, medical, or family issues (or other distressing events) outside their control that significantly affect preparation for, or completion of, assessments. These are known as extenuating circumstances (EC). - Exceptional – beyond normal daily life challenges. - Outside the student’s control – unavoidable and unpreventable. - Significant negative impact – clear, significant effect on ability to study or take assessments. - Timely and relevant – typically short-term and close to the affected assessment/study period.
